blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-accessibility-1 (Delete action is a clickable div, unreachable with the keyboard) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-accessibility-2 (Icon-only delete control has no accessible name) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: Render the delete action as a native `<button type="button">` (keeping the `icon-button` class): it is focusable, exposes the button role and fires on Enter and Space. Today a keyboard user pressing Tab never lands on the control, and a screen reader user hears no button, so neither can delete a document — the one task the proposal adds. WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard, 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value. Check that the button keeps a visible focus style (2.4.7).
findings.title: Delete action is a clickable div, unreachable with the keyboard

findings.recommendation: Give the control a text name, for example `aria-label="Delete document"` on the button (or visually hidden text inside it). Its only content is `TrashIcon`, whose `<svg>` is `aria-hidden="true"` (src/components/icons.tsx), so even once it is a button a screen reader announces just "button" and the user cannot tell it deletes the document. WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content, 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value.
findings.title: Icon-only delete control has no accessible name

findings.recommendation: Add an `alt`. The component's comment says the avatar shows the document's owner, so it conveys meaning: pass the owner's name in the props and use it (`alt={ownerName}`); if the owner's name is already shown as text next to it, use `alt=""` instead. Without `alt`, screen readers announce the image file name or URL, and screen reader users never learn who owns the document. WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content.
findings.title: Owner avatar image has no alt attribute

findings.recommendation: The icon is 16 by 16 and the `icon-button` stylesheet is not in the change: check that the delete control is at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels (or spaced enough), that its icon meets the 3:1 non-text contrast, and that it shows a visible focus indicator. WCAG 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum), 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast, 2.4.7 Focus Visible.
findings.title: Delete target size and focus style not visible in the change
